title: 214 Kangxi radical families with mainland forms and positional variants
releaseStatus: cnchar-order-backed mainland dataset with explicitly labelled supplemental entries
recommendedChineseFontFamily: KaiTi, STKaiti, AR PL UKai CN, serif
notes: 214 radical family IDs are preserved. canonical selects the mainland representative; kangxiHeading is a historical cross-reference, not an alternative Taiwan writing sequence.
Variants are the C-locale inventory from cjklib plus its isolated radical forms. This is not a claim to include every historical or calligraphic variant.
Every strokeSequence element is one stroke, in writing order. Compound strokes are not split.

For exact forms present in cnchar-order 3.2.6, the sequence comes from that plugin. Some ambiguous cnchar stroke names are narrowed using a compatible existing named-stroke record; otherwise ambiguity is retained in strokeDefinitions.
cnchar-order-covered means dataset-backed, not independently certified against an official standard.
Supplemental entries absent from cnchar-order retain their documented source or derivation; these need separate review.
Only mainland records are included. No Taiwan stroke sequences are offered.
familyPinyin is the dictionary reading of the radical family, not the teaching name of every component variant.
Positional variants retain their exact glyph; a whole-character equivalent must not be used as a substitute.
